name: API Audit Drush Command
description: Provides Drush commands to list headless/decoupled API routes and audit them for open access and access-control misconfigurations.
project_description: API Audit Drush Command provides Drush commands for auditing the API routes of a headless or decoupled Drupal site. It discovers API routes (routes with a non-HTML _format requirement, plus JSON:API and REST resource routes) and reports routes with open access, missing access requirements, and potential access-control misconfigurations. The audit assigns each finding a severity (info, warning, critical) based on the route's access requirements, HTTP methods, and route type, cross-referencing the anonymous role's actual permissions. It ships no web UI, permissions, or configuration; it is run entirely from the command line and requires Drush 12 or 13.
